gameDescription: Tilt the world, not the ball. Guide a golden hamster in a glass ball across a floating Halloween harvest world: narrow plank walkways, spinning scarecrow discs, jack-o'-lantern bumpers, conveyor belts and launch ramps drifting in a violet twilight sky. Collect wrapped candy, roll through the glowing jack-o'-lantern goal before the 60-second timer runs out, and don't fall off the world. A comic-book take on the arcade tilt-and-roll classic.
